info.name: Realistan One Backend
info.description:
Complete API collection for Realistan One Backend.

Import this collection then import the three environment files (env_local.json, env_dev.json, env_prod.json).

Token variables — set these in collection variables after login:
- re_token          Realestate JWT
- se_access_token   ServeEase access token
- se_refresh_token  ServeEase refresh token
- admin_token       Admin JWT
